title: Harness State Action Controls and Confirmation

text.insert: by evidence; enabled controls display expected_transition. The client never enables an action by independently inspecting workflow state.

A confirmation dialog appears only when confirmation_required is true. Outward-facing, work-discarding, and terminal actions use that path; routine pause, resume, start, conflict resolution, save-point, and knowledge processing actions submit directly. Server rejection after a stale projection refreshes the view and displays the current blockers.
The dated confirmation decision and complete 21-action matrix remain owned by
; this UI applies each projected confirmation_required value without reclassifying actions.
